mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.name, o.code, o.parent_id, o.level, o.sort, o.status, o.description FROM ums_organization o WHERE o.status = 1 ORDER BY o.level, o.sort

SELECT DISTINCT o.id FROM ums_organization o WHERE o.status = 1 AND ( -- 超级管理员可以访问所有组织 EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ums_admin_role_relation ar JOIN ums_role r ON ar.role_id = r.id WHERE ar.admin_id = #{adminId} AND r.name = '超级管理员' ) OR -- 部门管理员可以访问其有权限的组织及下级组织 o.id IN ( SELECT ro.organization_id FROM ums_admin_role_relation ar JOIN ums_role_organization_relation ro ON ar.role_id = ro.role_id WHERE ar.admin_id = #{adminId} AND ro.scope = 0 ) OR -- 部门管理员可以访问其有权限的组织及下级组织 o.id IN ( WITH RECURSIVE org_tree AS ( SELECT ro.organization_id FROM ums_admin_role_relation ar JOIN ums_role_organization_relation ro ON ar.role_id = ro.role_id WHERE ar.admin_id = #{adminId} AND ro.scope = 1 UNION ALL SELECT o.id FROM ums_organization o JOIN org_tree ot ON o.parent_id = ot.organization_id ) SELECT organization_id FROM org_tree ) )
WITH RECURSIVE org_tree AS ( SELECT #{organizationId} AS id UNION ALL SELECT o.id FROM ums_organization o JOIN org_tree ot ON o.parent_id = ot.id ) SELECT id FROM org_tree
